description: Create a Stripe checkout link for a credit top-up or a plan upgrade. Requires an API key. Nothing is charged: give the checkout_url to your human, who pays on Stripe's page; credits or the new plan are applied automatically after payment. Only upgrades are possible; downgrades and cancellations must be done by the human in the dashboard.

interval.description: Billing interval for kind=plan only. Default: month. Ignored for top-ups.

item.description: Id of the top-up or plan, as listed by ujeebu_plans (e.g. 'mini' for a top-up, 'starter' for a plan).

kind.description: 'topup' for a one-off credit pack (credits never expire) or 'plan' for a subscription upgrade.

name: ujeebu_checkout_link
